signals_info.description: Ego-vehicle speed while approaching or traversing an intersection.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At all times, the ego vehicle speed shall be less than 30 kilometers per hour.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在所有时刻，自车速度应低于 30 千米每小时。
nl_Paraphrase_en: While traversing the intersection scene, the vehicle shall remain below 30 km/h.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车辆通过路口期间，车速应始终低于 30 千米每小时。
